name: text-scramble-decode
title: Scramble Decode
description: Chữ bắt đầu là các ký tự ngẫu nhiên đổi 25 lần mỗi giây, sau 0.5 giây thì chốt dần đúng chữ từ trái sang.

moworks.author: takayu

options.delay: s before letters start to lock (0.5)
options.backAt: s it scrambles again from the right (2.95)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-scramble-decode, written here): Text starts as random glyphs of each char's class (upper / lower / digits; kana for CJK), changing at 25 fps (seeded per char and frame; demo accent 90 %). After a 0.5 s reveal delay real chars lock left → right, evenly over ~1 s (demo min(1.1 s, 90 ms × n), from 0.75 s), linear. GSAP ScrambleText: 1 s, chars 'upperCase', revealDelay 0.5, speed 0.3. Demo loop: from 2.95 s chars fall back to noise from the right over 0.25 s, fade 3.2–3.4 s; loop 3.4 s. Params: duration (1 s) · revealDelay (0.5 s) · chars: bộ ký tự (chữ hoa) · fps nhiễu (25) · seed.
moworks.titleVi: Chữ nhiễu rồi giải mã từ trái sang
